ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Low ratio; predominantly low-intensity dark pixels (estimated >90%) with sparse high-intensity white and light-grey pixel clusters.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Solid dark-grey/black field across entire visible surface. Scattered small-scale white speckling is localized in the upper-medial region of the left lobe and sporadically near the median notch.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression; interior angle approximately 45-50 degrees relative to lobe horizontal baselines.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations observed across the entire trailing edge. Right lobe displays more pronounced vertical pixel-amplitude variations (jagged peaks) than the left.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetric convex upward sweep originating from the peduncle attachment point toward the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-density clusters of high-contrast yellowish-white pixel clusters located at the extreme distal tips (apexes) of both lobes, representing significant localized surface accretion.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint, unaligned thin white linear pixel disruptions visible on the surface of the right lobe, oriented diagonally toward the trailing edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive textured colonization at the lateral tips of both lobes creates a modified, irregular terminal boundary compared to the smooth natural curve.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced three-dimensional textured masses localized at the extreme lateral edges of both lobes, creating distinct high-contrast pixel boundaries against the background.
